title: We build it. You own it.
styleLine: Kymbo scene photography for the ownership piece — see profiles/kymbo/build/prompts/VISUAL.md. World: same Kymbo software-studio as scenes 21/22, but the mood is HANDOVER and INDEPENDENCE — a room that already belongs to someone else. Walls off-white plaster (#EDEAE4) or unpainted concrete. Floor dark polished concrete or dark oak. Walnut desks with visible wear. Palette: near-black cool-neutral shadows (#0A0D14), cool near-white highlights (#F1F3F6). Metal is brushed steel or MATTE BLACK, with occasional brass keys (the exception — because keys are the metaphor). Objects read as REAL WORK ALREADY DONE HERE: notebooks with pages of abstract non-readable notes, cracked spine, coffee-stained corners; hardcover books with torn dust jackets; chipped ceramic mugs; coiled cables; matte-black laptops with used cases. Documentary, unposed — Apartamento or The Gentlewoman feel. 35mm color negative, ONE dominant side-window key at morning (7-9am) or late afternoon (4-6pm), clear light side, deep near-black shadow side. Composition: off-center, asymmetric weight, one object cropped by the frame edge. UNIVERSALLY PROHIBITED: succulents, round white ceramic pots, fiddle-leaf figs, monstera, jute or sisal rugs, terrazzo, perfectly stacked photogenic books, fresh flowers in glass, Apple tastemaker signals, motivational wall art, pastel walls (teal/sage/blush cast), symmetric three-object triangles, centered composition, soft even daylight, blown-out backlit windows, ceremonial 'handover' poses, styled 'reading nook' clichés, 'aesthetic curated moodboard' feel. 4:5 native (1080x1350), do NOT letterbox / pad / extend / outpaint. Fill the ENTIRE 4:5 frame — CSS overlay handles text; NO dark band or vignette. No visible text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces (hands, over-the-shoulder fine).
note: Path B. All six pure editorial photos — no composites.

slides.imagePrompt: A specific corner of a walnut desk in the ~5pm late-afternoon side-window slice: a set of three modern brass keys on a small dark leather tray, placed OFF-CENTER LEFT on the desk (NOT ceremonial, NOT posed). RIGHT third breathes: a chipped ceramic mug intrudes from the edge with coffee at 2/3 level. Foreground: a coffee ring on the desk near the tray. Behind: unpainted concrete wall with visible texture, no decoration. Hard warm-cool side-window key from left; the topmost brass key catches a small specular highlight. Deep near-black shadow on the tray's right side. PROHIBITED IN THIS FRAME: no succulents, no plants, no round white pots, no jute rug, no pastel wall, no symmetric key arrangement, no ceremonial 'handover' pose. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.headline:
We build it.
==You own it.==
slides.sub: Source code. Hosting. Domain. Fire us tomorrow and nothing breaks.

slides.imagePrompt: An over-the-shoulder view of hands (wrist down only, no face) holding an OPEN paper notebook on a walnut desk, ~7pm late side-window slice. The notebook page shows abstract non-readable notes (short lines, boxes, arrows suggesting a system diagram). Cracked spine. Right hand holds a pen mid-thought (small ink mark on the barrel). Foreground: coffee ring on the desk, a coiled charging cable trailing off the edge. Behind: unpainted concrete wall in soft focus. Hard warm side-window key from behind-left; wrist is rim-lit, page is partially shadowed. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no plants, no round pots, no clean unmarked notebook page, no perfect symmetric hand position, no pastel wall. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.title: Your ==code==. Your server. Your domain.
slides.body: The source code lives in your repo, not ours. The server is your account. The domain sits on your registrar. Handover is a folder we transfer, not a permission we grant.

slides.imagePrompt: A small studio shelf mounted on an unpainted concrete wall, ~10am morning side-window slice. Three books stacked HORIZONTALLY (NOT spines-out) on the shelf, at the LEFT third of the frame, with slightly askew alignment — the top book's dust jacket is torn at the corner. Right third: a chipped ceramic mug sits on the same shelf, empty. Below the shelf: a coiled cable hangs over the edge. Behind: unpainted concrete wall texture visible. Hard morning side-window key from upper-left, deep near-black shadow on the books' right edges. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no plants, no round white pots, no perfectly stacked spines-out books, no pastel wall, no photo frame or wall art with visible text. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.title: No ==proprietary== CMS
slides.body: WordPress, Shopify, Woo — code that thousands of developers already know. If we vanish, any competent shop can pick up your project by tomorrow.

slides.imagePrompt: A single dark leather accent chair (visibly worn — a crease on the seat, a small scuff on the arm) positioned at the LEFT third of a Kymbo studio room, cool morning side-window light streaming from the RIGHT third. Foreground: dark polished concrete floor. On a small walnut side-table beside the chair: a chipped ceramic mug with coffee at 2/3 level, and a matte-black hardcover book with a torn dust jacket. Behind the chair, out of focus: an unpainted concrete wall. NO plant in the frame at all — this is a room about independence, not decoration. Hard side-window key from right, the chair's seat catches direct light, the back-left recess goes near-black. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no plants, no round white pots, no jute rug, no pastel wall, no throw blanket, no styled 'reading nook' cliché. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.title: Why ==lock-in== exists
slides.body: Proprietary systems are the vendor's leverage over you. A page builder that only their team can edit is a dependency dressed up as a feature.

slides.imagePrompt: Overhead 45° angle onto a walnut table between two seats: two chipped ceramic mugs, one on each side of the frame, positioned OFF-CENTER (the LEFT mug slightly closer to the camera than the RIGHT). Both have coffee at DIFFERENT levels — LEFT mug at 1/2, RIGHT mug at 2/3 (the conversation has been going a while, one drinks faster). Between them: a small notebook open, pen resting across it, abstract non-readable marks. Coffee rings on the table. No plants, no props. Hard warm side-window key from upper-left, deep near-black shadow between the two mugs. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no round white pots, no fresh flowers, no styled cheek-to-cheek symmetric placement, no pastel wall. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.title: The ==relationship== after launch
slides.body: Care Plan is a monthly conversation, not a subscription trap. If you don't need us next month, you cancel and everything you own stays yours.

slides.imagePrompt: A specific OPEN door in the wall of a Kymbo studio, morning warm side-light flooding in from beyond the door and casting a long light rectangle on the dark polished concrete floor inside. LEFT third of the frame: the interior of the studio in near-black shadow (a chair silhouette visible). RIGHT third: the door open at ~40° angle to the interior, hard rim-light on the door edge and jamb. Foreground: the concrete floor with visible grain. NO trailing plant, NO stagey door-frame decoration. Composition is asymmetric — most of the frame is dark interior, the door and light spill occupy the right third. Hard directional morning light from beyond the door. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no plants, no round white pots, no jute rug, no pastel wall, no welcome mat, no styled 'exit sign' or motivational metaphor prop. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.headline:
The door is
==always open.==
slides.sub: Care Plan month-to-month. Cancel any time. Take everything with you.
